semiconductor_relevance: High — Solar Plus Company is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor tapes and adhesive films, crucial for various assembly processes in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Solar Plus Company specializes in the fabrication of high-performance tapes and adhesive films for the semiconductor industry. They offer custom solutions and OEM services, focusing on products like UV release tape and wafer back grinding tape, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Solar Plus Company is the No.1 semiconductor tape/film manufacturer in Taiwan, supporting the local semiconductor industry.
